user.title: Connect to SunnyHome
user.description:
SunnyHome is a monitoring and automation service for solar homes. This integration sends SunnyHome the live values of your SolaX Modbus inverter every 10 s, and the switches, lights and sensors you choose later under Configure. SunnyHome can then show them on its dashboard, use them in automation rules and, only if you allow it, switch the devices you tick. HA connects out to SunnyHome only; nothing is opened to the internet.

To pair: in SunnyHome, open your account, choose **Connect Home Assistant** and enter the code shown there.

data_description.url: Leave the default unless you run a development server.

init.title: Devices shared with SunnyHome
init.description:
**Whole devices:** tick a Home Assistant device under "Whole devices" to share all of it at once, including entities it gets later: its switches and lights, door, window and motion sensors, heating and air conditioning, selects and numbers (for example an air conditioner's fan mode or a display brightness) and its numeric sensors (any kind, for example power, energy, humidity or signal). Disabled and hidden entities are never sent, nor diagnostic ones other than sensors. **A whole device also shares its control:** once control is allowed for this connection in SunnyHome, SunnyHome can switch its switches and lights, set its heating and air conditioning (target, low and high target, mode, preset), choose a select's option and set a number, always within what the device itself allows. Devices of inverter, battery and energy integrations, devices the Energy dashboard uses and the entities chosen for the Other wallbox are never shared this way and are not offered.

Only the ticked switches and lights are shared with SunnyHome: their name, state and brightness. SolaX Modbus entities are never offered.

**Control:** SunnyHome can switch on and off, and dim, the devices ticked under "Devices SunnyHome may control" once control is also allowed for this connection in SunnyHome. Heating and hot water entities ticked above can be ticked here too. Never tick a switch of an inverter, battery or EV charger there.

**Sensors:** SunnyHome receives the value, unit and time of the temperature, power, energy, battery, voltage, current, humidity, gas and water sensors ticked under "Sensors SunnyHome may read", for its automation rules and the Device widget.

**Binary sensors and people:** SunnyHome receives only the on or off state of the door, window, garage door, opening, motion and occupancy sensors ticked under "Binary sensors SunnyHome may see", and only home or away for the people ticked under "People SunnyHome may see". It never receives a person's zone, place name, coordinates or device trackers. They are read only and shown on the Device widget; SunnyHome never controls them.

**Heating and hot water:** SunnyHome receives only the mode, current and target temperature, allowed temperature range and available modes of the heat pumps, thermostats and water heaters ticked under "Heating and hot water SunnyHome may read", and whether a thermostat is heating or cooling. Nothing else of them is sent. They are shown on the Device widget. SunnyHome sets a target temperature or mode only for the ones also ticked under "Devices SunnyHome may control", and only once control is allowed for this connection in SunnyHome. For a change made by an automation rule (a target, a low and high target, a mode, a preset, a select's option or a number), Home Assistant puts the previous value back when the rule stops renewing it, but only if nobody changed it by hand meanwhile.

data.heat: Heating and hot water SunnyHome may read

data_description.devices: Everything allowed of each device is shared and may be controlled, also entities added later. At most 512 entities and 512 sensors together with the lists below. Leave empty and no whole device is shared.
data_description.control: Each must also be ticked under Shared devices or Heating and hot water. Leave empty and SunnyHome controls nothing.
data_description.sensors: At most 32. Leave empty and SunnyHome reads no sensors.
data_description.binary_sensors: Door, window, garage door, opening, motion and occupancy sensors: on or off only. Together with the shared devices, people and heating at most 64. Leave empty and SunnyHome sees none.
data_description.people: Only home or away is sent, never where the person is. Together with the shared devices, binary sensors and heating at most 64. Leave empty and SunnyHome sees no one.
data_description.heat: Climate entities (heat pumps, thermostats) and water heaters (boilers): only the mode and temperatures. Together with the shared devices, binary sensors and people at most 64. Leave empty and SunnyHome reads none.

inverter.title: Inverter control
inverter.description:
**Warning: this lets SunnyHome charge and discharge your home battery through the SolaX inverter.**

When on, SunnyHome may put the inverter of your SolaX Modbus hub into a remote battery mode for 2 to 10 minutes at a time: charge or discharge at up to 1500 W, hold the battery, or don't discharge it (it may still charge from solar). It uses only the hub's direct remote-control entities and only these modes. Nothing is sent unless SunnyHome has verified your inverter model, firmware and SolaX Modbus version, and you also allow inverter control in SunnyHome.

Home Assistant ends the mode itself when SunnyHome stops renewing it, also after a restart. If Home Assistant stops reporting for 3 minutes while a mode runs, SunnyHome ends the mode through the SolaX cloud, as long as its SolaX cloud connection to your plant works and inverter control is allowed in SunnyHome. Otherwise the mode keeps running until Home Assistant is back and ends it; the inverter's own timeout did not end it in our test. If something else controls the inverter remotely (another energy manager or automation), SunnyHome does not start a mode, and it steps back when it sees another mode. Turning this off ends an active mode at once.

data.inverter_control: Allow SunnyHome to control the inverter's battery mode

wallbox.title: Wallbox control
wallbox.description:
**Warning: this lets SunnyHome change the work mode of your SolaX EV charger.**

When on, SunnyHome's wallbox rules may set the charger of your SolaX Modbus EV charger hub to STOP, FAST, ECO or GREEN. FAST charges at full power from any source, including the grid. For GREEN and ECO it sets the charger's Green gear or ECO gear to 6 A and does not set it back. It never starts or stops a charging session. Nothing is sent unless SunnyHome has verified your charger model, firmware and SolaX Modbus version, and you also allow EV charging control in SunnyHome.

Home Assistant returns the charger to the wallbox's normal mode about 15 minutes after SunnyHome stops renewing a mode, also after a restart. If Home Assistant itself is down, the charger keeps the mode. A mode you change by hand is left as it is. SunnyHome needs the hub to scan every 30 seconds or faster. Turning this off returns an active mode to the normal mode.

data.wallbox_control: Allow SunnyHome to set the EV charger's work mode

other_wallbox.title: Other wallbox
other_wallbox.description:
Optional: share another EV charger that Home Assistant already shows (for example an Easee, Zaptec, Wallbox or OCPP charger), so SunnyHome can show its charging power and session energy.

**What is shared:** the state and unit of the power sensor, of the optional session energy sensor and status sensor, and the state of the charging current number (its set point in amps, and its minimum and maximum). SunnyHome reads nothing else of the charger. Choose the power sensor and the charging current number together, or leave both empty if you have no other wallbox.

**Warning: control lets SunnyHome set this charger's charging current.** When control is on and you also allow EV charging control in SunnyHome, its wallbox rules may set the charging current number between 6 A and the number's maximum (at most 32 A): FAST uses the maximum, ECO 6 A, and STOP switches the charger off with the switch you chose (without a switch, only a number that accepts 0 A is set to 0). SunnyHome never starts or ends a charging session itself. Nothing is sent until a physical check has verified your charger model.

Home Assistant puts the previous current and switch state back when SunnyHome stops renewing a setting (within 30 minutes), also after a restart, but only if you did not change them by hand meanwhile. If Home Assistant itself is down, the charger keeps its setting. Turning control off puts the previous values back at once.

data.other_wallbox_control: Allow SunnyHome to set this charger's charging current

data_description.other_wallbox_power: The charger's charging power (a power sensor, in W or kW). Required together with the charging current number.
data_description.other_wallbox_current: The number that sets the charging current in amps, with its own minimum and maximum. Required together with the power sensor.
data_description.other_wallbox_switch: Switches the charging on and off. With it, STOP switches it off; without it, STOP needs a number that accepts 0 A.
data_description.other_wallbox_energy: The energy of the current charging session (an energy sensor, in kWh or Wh). Leave empty if the charger has none.
data_description.other_wallbox_status: A text such as Charging or Disconnected; only short plain text is sent. Leave empty if the charger has none.
data_description.other_wallbox_control: Off by default. Read the warning above; SunnyHome also needs EV charging control allowed in SunnyHome.

error.too_many: Choose at most 64 devices, binary sensors, people and heating entities together.
error.control_not_shared: Devices SunnyHome may control must also be ticked as shared devices or as heating and hot water.
error.needs_both: Choose both the power sensor and the charging current number, or leave both empty.
error.number_unit: The charging current number must be in amperes (A).
error.number_range: The charging current number needs a minimum and a maximum that allow some current between 6 A and 32 A.
error.device_not_shareable: This device cannot be shared as a whole: it belongs to an inverter, battery or energy integration, the Energy dashboard uses it, or it is gone.
error.too_many_device_entities: The whole devices and the lists below have more than 512 entities or 512 sensors together.

multiple_hubs.title: Several inverter integrations are not supported yet
multiple_hubs.description: SunnyHome found more than one inverter integration entry (SolaX Modbus, GoodWe or Deye), so it sends no inverter data. Keep a single one to resume sending.

server_older.title: SunnyHome does not take whole devices yet
server_older.description: This SunnyHome server is older than this integration, so the whole devices ticked in the options are not sent; the entities ticked one by one still are. Nothing needs to be done: they are sent as soon as SunnyHome is updated.

devices_trimmed.title: Some entities of whole devices are not sent
devices_trimmed.description: The whole devices ticked in the options have more entities than SunnyHome takes (512 entities and 512 sensors, or the size of one report), so only the first ones by entity id are sent. Untick a device or share its entities one by one.
